description: This source file defines the final class RetrieveThing, which represents a command for retrieving a specific Thing by its ID in the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class includes mechanisms for constructing the command, serializing/deserializing to JSON, and accessing command parameters such as selected fields and snapshot revisions.

classes.name: RetrieveThing
classes.description: Immutable command class for retrieving a Thing by its ID, supporting serialization to and from JSON, with optional field selection and snapshot revision.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of RetrieveThing using a typed ThingId and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a RetrieveThing instance from a JSON string or object, deserializing fields including the Thing ID, selected fields, and snapshot revision.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Provides a builder for constructing an immutable RetrieveThing instance.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns an optional JsonFieldSelector defining which fields of the Thing to retrieve.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing to be retrieved.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer, indicating the resource path for this command.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes command parameters into a JSON payload, respecting the schema version.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new RetrieveThing instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getSnapshotRevision
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the snapshot revision number if specified.
